candidate.kind: directional | incremental_filter | conditioning | removal_filter (information-mode trials are refused)
candidate.plan_entry_sha256: must equal the frozen plan entry
candidate.plan_id: frozen P2-D0 plan id, e.g. P2D-R1-H01-004

evidence.claimed_positions: optional [[symbol, t_ms]] cross-checked against the P2-D0 rebuild
evidence.day_context: {day: {regime: H04 broad regime at the daily decision (PIT) | null, bench: {BENCH-CASH, BENCH-BTC-TREND, BENCH-TSMOM: day return under EXEC-BASE}}}
evidence.registration: tsb.p2f.candidate_registration (contracts.registration): F0 / P2-D0 / P2-X v2 hashes, considered_trials (every trial of the round), selection_rule, ledger_anchor, code_commit, forward_registration (forward windows only)
evidence.risk_inputs: REFUSED until a P2-RM contract (D-RM0-2 closed) is bound by a later F version
evidence.rows: every eligible decision row of every symbol of the universe known at T inside the window (not only signal rows)

window.day_start_ms: {day: UTC start of that eligible day}
window.validation_days: eligible-day indices; in-sample must equal the frozen layout

principle: P2-F0 receives the candidate's FULL eligible decision-row panel for the evaluation window and recomputes positions, statistics and placebos itself; claimed positions or metrics are only cross-checked, never used

row.ctrl: optional: the P2-D0 control rule for the hypothesis (default: every eligible row)
row.depth_ok_500: EXEC-BASE displayed-depth walk supports 500 USDT on both legs (null = unknown)
row.elig: 1 when every feature the trial uses is non-null at T (P2-D0 evaluability)
row.feat_avail_ms: max available_at_ms over the features used (must be <= t_ms)
row.gross: mkt.fwd_ret_{h} (null = unknown outcome, kept in counts)
row.label_end_ms: end of the label window (>= t_ms + horizon)
row.net_base: EXEC-BASE net round trip (null = execution refusal)
row.net_idealized: EXEC-IDEALIZED net round trip (reported only; never supports a verdict)
row.sig: 1 when the trial's rule fires at T (before the position rule)
row.sym: Binance spot symbol (one quote currency per evidence bundle)

verdict_record: tsb.p2f.verdict v1: profile, protocol id / version, f0_contract_set_sha256, thresholds_status, candidate, window, verdict, binding_effect, reasons, tests {status PASS | FAIL | UNDETERMINABLE | NOT_RUN | NOT_APPLICABLE, effect_if_not_pass, numbers, reason}, info, verdict_id
